invariants.rationale: HoodieJavaTable.create(config, context) is expected to always create and return a non-null HoodieTable.
The return type of the method is HoodieTable, and result is the (non-null) value returned from HoodieJavaTable.create(...).
Method cannot create a hoodie table without configuration; result depends on config being non-null.
A non-null HoodieEngineContext is required to call HoodieJavaTable.create and to return a HoodieTable.
